philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.description: I believe we only live once, so we should live the life we desire, not the one others expect of us. I pursue work-life balance, considering it super cool to do what I love (like traveling or taking care of my family) while working. It might be a tough goal, but I believe I can pull it off. Even if it takes a long time or I fail, I won't give up. I'll keep moving forward on this path and never look back.
